en.name: SQL Query
en.description: Generate a SQL query from a plain English description.

fr.name: Requête SQL
fr.description: Générez une requête SQL depuis une description en langage naturel.

blocks.content: You are a database expert proficient in SQL.
Write the SQL query that matches the request in the Input block.
{{describe what you want to query}} — e.g. "Top 10 users by order value in the last 30 days"
{{schema}} — e.g. "users(id, name), orders(id, user_id, total, created_at)"

- PostgreSQL syntax unless specified
- Comment each major clause
- Handle NULLs and edge cases
SQL in a code block + plain-English explanation.
